title: [review] lora_ipv6_mesh-mkk4: rust/target/ build artifacts committed
description:
Commit d83cbc5 (lora_ipv6_mesh-mkk4: fix) accidentally staged and committed 3 build artifacts from rust/target/:
- rust/target/debug/deps/lichen_gateway-f1ce66f1c4497e73.d (depfile)
- rust/target/debug/incremental/lichen_gateway-22bf9b6an4f75/s-hkp20uavb7-14gy7hh-working/dep-graph.part.bin (incremental compilation binary)
- rust/target/debug/incremental/lichen_gateway-22bf9b6an4f75/s-hkp20uavb7-14gy7hh.lock (build lock)

These are generated by cargo build and should not be in version control. The rust/target/ directory should be in .gitignore. The SosResource export fix in the same commit is correct and should be preserved.
